data.body:
Implemented and pushed for review as Gerrit change 1928 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1928), commit 8b6828c275, branched from origin/main 46b5d60f6f.

RED-first evidence: test_project_criterion_glob_matching_no_changed_file_is_not_dispatched failed on unmodified main (the criterion WAS dispatched), and all four malformed-applies_to overlay-load cases DID NOT RAISE.

Changes:
- code_review/registry.py: project_applies_to_globs() reads effective_routing(repo_root) (never the packaged routing_index(), which has no project. entries); project_criterion_applies() returns True on an empty glob list, else any _glob_match over the changed files.
- workflow/gate_dispatch.py: _activated_code_review_project_criteria(repo_root, changed_files=()) drops a glob-gated criterion matching none; the call site threads prep.dc.changed_files.
- criteria/overlay.py: _validate_routing_entry now rejects a non-list / non-string element / empty-string glob applies_to at overlay load. The applies_at cluster moved unchanged to _validate_applies_at so both stay under the complexity ceiling (ratchet: new=0 increased=0, stale=1).
- docs/adr/0074 + docs/llm-framework.md: records that applies_to is honoured for project criteria and the empty-list semantic collision (built-in = escalation-only; project = ungated, forced because project ids are not in OVERLAY_IDS).

Scope held: no applies_to_config_key, no new config key, and config.py / _config_schema.py / _config_sections.py / config_surface.json untouched.

project.review-phase-boundaries proven always-on by test_repo_criterion_is_dispatched_whatever_changed, parametrized over four changed-file sets (including the empty list) against the REAL .rebar/criteria_routing.json.

make lint + make typecheck pass; 1538 related unit tests pass.
